newsitem.title: UK: DMG confirms equities trading head to leave. [CORRECTED 11:24 GMT]
newsitem.headline: DMG confirms equities trading head to leave. [CORRECTED 11:24 GMT]

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, the investment banking arm of Germany's Deutsche Bank, confirmed on Wednesday that its head of equities trading Ian Wace (corrects from Weiss) was leaving the bank.

"He is to leave the company at the end of the month on a very amicable basis," DMG spokesman Markus Will told Reuters, adding that Wace was setting up his own consultancy business and would initially be working as a consultant for DMG.
Will also confirmed that two other individuals Steve Briddle, head of continental European trading, and an analyst had both left DMG.
A replacement for Wace has yet to be appointed by Mike Philipp, global head of equities at DMG.
